items.title: 3 Diversified Chemical Stocks to Watch Amid Industry Headwinds
items.summary: Sluggish demand in key end markets and softness in Europe and China have put a dent in the Zacks Chemicals Diversified industry. DOW, DD and MEOH are poised to navigate the industry challenges.

items.title: 4 Dividend Stocks That Can Thrive Under a Democratic Congress
items.summary: Washington is split, gridlock looms, and income investors need payouts that survive without help from Congress. One chipmaker, one chemicals company that already cut its dividend, and two household names make the case, but each carries a risk worth knowing.

items.title: Here's Why You Should Hold DOW Stock in Your Portfolio for Now
items.summary: DOW's growth investments, cost-saving initiatives and strong cash flow support its outlook, despite weak demand and cost pressures.

items.title: X-Energy Can Construct Its First Nuclear Reactors, U.S. Says
items.summary: The company said it received a construction permit to build four small reactors in Texas.

items.title: 2 Chemical Giants Cut Their Dividends. This Third Stock Kept Raising
items.summary: Overcapacity, Middle East turmoil, and shaky margins have forced some chemical makers to shrink the checks they send shareholders. Retirees chasing yield in this sector face one question: whose payout is built on cash flow, and whose still carries risk?

items.title: Western Union Yields 13.5%. Is This Dividend Stock a Trap?
items.summary: The payout hasn't moved in years, yet the yield keeps climbing because investors keep dumping the stock. We tested three high-yield names on earnings, cash flow, and debt, and one of them is paying dividends from reserves.

items.title: AI demand isn't going anywhere, but volatility lies ahead

items.title: The Median Home In America’s Best Place To Retire Is Worth About $206,000, Far Below The National Average. U.S. News Picked This Michigan City Over Florida Again
items.summary: Florida keeps pulling Michigan retirees south, yet a Great Lakes city just beat every Sunshine State town for the top spot. The real surprise is how one tax rule and your account choices decide the nest egg you need.
